data.name: Araam
data.gender_notes: Araam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Araam is derived from the Arabic root 'r-m-m' which means 'to be high, to rise, to be exalted, and to be noble'. In Islamic tradition, Araam is considered a name for a noble, virtuous, and exalted person. The name Araam carries the meaning “High, exalted, noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Araam usually hope their child will grow to embody high, exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name signifying spiritual elevation and nobility in Islam.
data.etymology: Araam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “High, exalted, noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Araam total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
